authorship: Codex-authored strategy compression of all original eight Train-based mechanisms; no optimizer API generation.
word_target_scope: 100–160 strategy words; inherited when_to_use is unchanged and combined words are reported separately.
interpretation: Joint diagnostic of execution-step granularity and text length; not a pure format intervention or a claim of complete semantic equivalence.
data_boundary: Only original eight Train-based card procedures and their recorded Train design basis; no final benchmark comparisons, Gate diagnostics, GT or scoring points used.

mechanisms.compression_difference: Merge reference initialization and reuse, retain the sequential dependency and conditional joint check, and remove repeated request-field signatures.
mechanisms.counterexample: Already supplied or adequately established anchors should be reused; independent requests should remain parallelizable.

mechanisms.compression_difference: Combine option qualification, local acquisition and remaining-choice checks; keep the original when unchanged rather than adopting the separate entry refinement.
mechanisms.counterexample: A candidate containing several required conditions cannot be established by inspecting only one convenient difference.

mechanisms.compression_difference: Merge candidate retention and feature checks, compress acquisition signatures, and retain initialization, elimination and unresolved-identity boundaries.
